rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=24, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0007, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-12 (one knob vs iter-11 best). NUMBERS n_bands(n_outer1): 6->RMSE0.005542, 8->0.005260, 12->0.005089(hr0.0240), 16->0.005074(hr0.0268 iter-11 BEST) -- RMSE decline DECELERATING (12->16 only -0.000015). SSIM easing 0.933->0.928 with finer bands. FAILURE MODE: n_bands lever approaching diminishing returns; the per-band back-projection count is rising (cost) for sub-1e-5 RMSE gains. ONE KNOB: wu_n_bands 16 -> 24 (bracket the optimum; n_outer/thresh/motion locked). HYPOTHESIS: if hr keeps rising past 0.0268 the band optimum is >24 and I would lock a high band count; if hr plateaus/falls (bands so narrow the ramp partition under-samples and per-band noise dominates, or SSIM erosion pulls RMSE back), the n_bands optimum brackets in (16,24) and iter-11 (or a bisect) is the classical operating point. Budget: 24 bands ~ 1.5x iter-11 back-projection, still well under 20min.
